title: Decoding on Graphs: Faithful and Sound Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs through Generation of Well-Formed Chains

layout.note: Three uneven columns of framed panels: a tall prompt panel at left, panel (c) above panel (b) in the middle, and (d), (e), (f) stacked at right. The reading path zigzags (a) to (b), up to (c), right to (d), down to (e) and (f), carried by thick black block arrows with circled numbers and verb labels placed in the gaps.

lesson: Join lettered panels by thick block arrows that carry a circled number and a verb phrase, so the method reads as a path through concrete artefacts; colour generated text by how it was produced so the contribution can be seen inside the answer.
